More precisely, we show that while stable models of positive logic programs correspond
逻辑编程与因果过程.summary_zh: 受生命科学中复杂建模问题的启发，本文研究了逻辑编程语义与兼容这些逻辑程序的因果过程最终状态之间的关系。具体而言，我们证明了正逻辑程序的稳定模型对应因果过程的某些吸引子状态，从而为生物系统中的因果推理提供了一种形式化框架。创新点在于建立了逻辑编程与因果过程之间的语义桥梁，主要贡献是揭示了稳定模型与因果过程最终状态之间的对应关系，为生命科学中的建模和推理提供了新的理论工具。

计算机视觉与视频理解.title: BasketEvent: Understanding Who Did What and When in Basketball Videos
计算机视觉与视频理解.title_zh: BasketEvent：理解篮球视频中谁做了什么以及何时发生
计算机视觉与视频理解.summary: Comprehensive basketball video understanding requires resolving not only what event occurs, but also who is responsible and when the key evidence appears. However, exist- ing methods typically treat spatial perception and semantic recognition as isolated tasks, failing to ground events to individual
计算机视觉与视频理解.summary_zh: 全面的篮球视频理解不仅需要识别发生的事件，还需要确定责任人和关键证据出现的时间。然而，现有方法通常将空间感知和语义识别视为孤立任务，未能将事件归因到具体个体。本文提出了BasketEvent框架，通过联合建模空间定位、个体识别和时间定位，实现了对篮球视频中“谁、做了什么、何时”的完整理解。创新点在于将事件检测、人物识别和时间定位统一到一个端到端框架中，主要贡献是构建了一个细粒度的篮球视频理解基准和高效的方法。

AI智能体与上下文管理.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
AI智能体与上下文管理.title_zh: 智能体上下文管理：将记忆和成本视为生命周期和架构问题来解决
AI智能体与上下文管理.summary: Production AI agents' failures are less often due to an inability to reason well and more often because they cannot manage what is in their reasoning context: conversation histories, large prompts, large tool definitions, and ballooning tool outputs. Agents drown in their own accumulating history wh
AI智能体与上下文管理.summary_zh: 生产环境中的AI智能体失败往往不是由于推理能力不足，而是因为它们无法管理推理上下文中的内容：对话历史、大型提示、大型工具定义以及不断膨胀的工具输出。智能体被自身不断累积的历史所淹没。本文提出了一种智能体上下文管理方法，将记忆和成本问题视为生命周期和架构问题来解决，通过分层的上下文结构和生命周期管理策略，显著降低了推理成本并提高了智能体的稳定性。创新点在于将上下文管理从单纯的内存问题提升为系统架构问题，主要贡献是提出了一个实用的生产级智能体上下文管理框架。

生成模型与离散扩散.title: Mean-to-Score Discrete Diffusion: Posterior-Mean Denoisers for Score Entropy
生成模型与离散扩散.title_zh: 均值到分数离散扩散：用于分数熵的后验均值去噪器
生成模型与离散扩散.summary: Score Entropy Discrete Diffusion (SEDD) parameterizes discrete reverse processes with unconstrained positive score ratios. While positivity guarantees nonnegative reverse jump rates, it does not ensure Bayes realizability: ratios at a noisy state need not be jointly induced by any clean-token poster
生成模型与离散扩散.summary_zh: 分数熵离散扩散（SEDD）使用无约束的正分数比率参数化离散逆过程。虽然正性保证了非负的逆跳转率，但它不能确保贝叶斯可实现性：噪声状态下的比率不一定由任何干净标记后验共同诱导。本文提出了均值到分数离散扩散方法，通过后验均值去噪器来改进分数熵，确保了贝叶斯一致性并提高了生成质量。创新点在于解决了SEDD中贝叶斯可实现性问题，主要贡献是提出了一种新的离散扩散模型训练范式，在多个离散数据生成任务上取得了更优的结果。

机器人学与导航.title: VoLN: Vision-Only Long-Horizon Navigation---Paradigm, Benchmark, and Method
机器人学与导航.title_zh: VoLN：纯视觉长程导航——范式、基准和方法
机器人学与导航.summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) enables embodied agents to follow natural-language instructions. However, route-level instructions commonly encode spatial priors, such as orientation, distance, and layout, that are not explicitly available from onboard sensing at deployment in open, GPS-denied
机器人学与导航.summary_zh: 视觉与语言导航（VLN）使具身智能体能够遵循自然语言指令。然而，路径级指令通常编码了空间先验信息，如方向、距离和布局，这些信息在开放、无GPS环境中部署时无法从机载传感器显式获得。本文提出了VoLN纯视觉长程导航框架，仅依赖视觉输入实现长距离导航，并建立了相应的基准数据集和方法。创新点在于去除了对语言指令中空间先验的依赖，主要贡献是提出了一个新的导航范式、基准和有效方法，推动了纯视觉导航在实际场景中的应用。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Adaptive Identity Anchoring: Closed-Loop Keyframe Placement for Synthetic Paired Supervision in Video Face Swapping
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 自适应身份锚定：用于视频换脸合成配对监督的闭环关键帧放置
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Video face swapping has no natural paired supervision: no real footage exists of one person's face performing another person's video. The strongest current answer, DreamID-V's SyncID-Pipe, mints pairs by replacing the identity in exactly two frames of a real clip -- the first and the last -- and reg
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 视频换脸缺乏天然成对监督：不存在一个人脸部执行另一个人视频的真实镜头。当前最强方案DreamID-V的SyncID-Pipe通过替换真实片段中恰好两帧（首帧和尾帧）的身份来生成配对，并回归中间帧。本文提出自适应身份锚定，一种闭环关键帧放置方法，动态选择关键帧以优化合成配对，从而提升换脸视频的时序一致性和身份保真度。创新点在于将关键帧选择视为可学习过程，通过闭环反馈调整放置策略，显著优于固定帧方案。

计算机视觉/CV.title: DINOde: Continuous Vision-Text Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: DINOde：面向开放词汇语义分割的连续视觉-文本对齐
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) leverages textual semantics to segment objects beyond predefined categories. While the self-supervised model DINOv3 provides strong structured visual representations, its lack of native textual alignment hinders its direct application to OVSS. To bridge t
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 开放词汇语义分割利用文本语义分割预定义类别之外的物体。自监督模型DINOv3提供强结构化视觉表征，但缺乏原生文本对齐，阻碍其直接应用。本文提出DINOde，通过连续视觉-文本对齐桥接这一鸿沟，将DINOv3的特征与CLIP文本嵌入对齐，无需额外标注。创新点在于设计连续对齐机制，在像素级别实现视觉与文本的细粒度匹配，从而在开放词汇分割任务上达到最先进水平，同时保持DINOv3的鲁棒性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: GraphVid: Interactive Graph-Controllable Video Generation
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: GraphVid：交互式图控制视频生成
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Controllable video generation remains challenging due to the difficulty of specifying precise multi-object interactions using text prompts or motion-control inputs that primarily constrain pixel movement. In practice, trajectory-based control often requires users to draw accurate tracks for multiple objects, which is labor-intensive. We propose GraphVid, a framework that represents scenes as spatiotemporal graphs, where nodes denote objects and edges denote interactions. Users can intuitively edit graphs to control object appearances, movements, and interactions. Our method leverages a graph-conditioned diffusion model to generate videos from graph inputs, enabling fine-grained control without manual trajectory drawing. Experiments show superior performance in multi-object video generation and editing tasks.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 可控视频生成因难以用文本提示或运动控制输入精确指定多物体交互而面临挑战。轨迹控制常需用户为多个物体绘制精确轨迹，劳动密集。本文提出GraphVid框架，将场景表示为时空图，节点代表物体，边代表交互。用户可直观编辑图以控制物体外观、运动和交互。该方法利用图条件扩散模型从图输入生成视频，实现无需手动轨迹绘制的细粒度控制。实验表明在多物体视频生成和编辑任务中性能优越。

计算机视觉/CV.title: ElasticTTT: Prior-Preserving Test-Time Tuning for Video Editing
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: ElasticTTT：保留先验的测试时调优用于视频编辑
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Test-Time Tuning (TTT) on pretrained diffusion models has emerged as a powerful paradigm for video editing. However, there exists a foundational mismatch between the distribution-mapping nature of generative models and the single-point optimization of standard TTT. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mismatch leads to degradation of prior knowledge and propose ElasticTTT, a method that introduces elastic constraints during TTT to preserve the model's generative prior while adapting to the input video. Specifically, we design a regularization term that penalizes deviation from the pretrained model's feature distribution. Extensive experiments show that ElasticTTT significantly improves editing fidelity and temporal consistency compared to prior TTT methods.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 测试时调优（TTT）在预训练扩散模型上已成为视频编辑的强大范式。然而，生成模型的分布映射性质与标准TTT的单点优化之间存在根本性不匹配。本文证明这种不匹配会导致先验知识退化，并提出ElasticTTT方法，在TTT过程中引入弹性约束，以在适应输入视频的同时保留模型的生成先验。具体地，设计了一个正则化项惩罚对预训练模型特征分布的偏离。大量实验表明，ElasticTTT相比先前TTT方法显著提高了编辑保真度和时间一致性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Unlearning Under Imbalance: Benchmarking Fairness in Multimodal LLM Unlearning
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 不平衡条件下的遗忘：多模态大语言模型遗忘中的公平性基准
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Machine unlearning has emerged as a tool for removing personal data from trained models to comply with recent AI regulations. To evaluate unlearning effectiveness in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), prior works fine-tune models on fictitious identities, simulating unlearning requests on subsets of data. However, these evaluations often overlook class imbalance, where some identities appear more frequently, leading to biased unlearning. We propose a benchmark that systematically studies the impact of data imbalance on unlearning fairness in MLLMs. We introduce metrics to measure both effectiveness and fairness across identity groups. Experiments show that existing unlearning methods exhibit significant performance disparities across imbalanced groups, and we propose a simple reweighting strategy to mitigate this issue.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 机器遗忘已成为从训练模型中移除个人数据以符合最新AI法规的工具。为评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的遗忘效果，先前工作通过虚构身份微调模型，模拟对数据子集的遗忘请求。然而，这些评估常忽略类别不平衡，某些身份出现更频繁，导致遗忘偏差。本文提出了一个基准，系统研究数据不平衡对MLLM遗忘公平性的影响。引入衡量遗忘有效性和跨身份组公平性的指标。实验表明现有遗忘方法在不平衡组间存在显著性能差异，并提出简单的重加权策略以缓解此问题。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
计算机视觉/CV.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is promising as it removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), yet it still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student to ensure that the self-teacher provides a stronger learning signal than the student. Existing methods cr
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）因去除了在线策略蒸馏所需的外部教师而具有前景，但仍需教师与学生之间的非对称信息，以确保自教师提供比学生更强的学习信号。现有方法通过引入对比学习来增强自蒸馏过程中的表示学习，提出了一种视觉对比自蒸馏框架，利用正负样本对构造对比损失，促使模型学习更鲁棒的特征表示。该方法在多个视觉基准任务上取得了优于传统蒸馏方法的性能，且无需额外的教师模型，显著降低了计算开销。创新点在于将对比学习与自蒸馏有机结合，实现了高效的特征学习。

计算机视觉/CV.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 具有隐式和显式几何的3D感知视觉语言模型
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Despite rapid progress, most existing vision-language models (VLMs) built from 2D visual inputs often struggle when handling various 3D tasks that require fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning. To bridge this gap, we present VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that enhances the 3D spatial awareness of VLMs by integrating both implicit and explicit 3D representations. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple 3D reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the importance of combining implicit and explicit geometries for 3D-aware VLMs.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 尽管进展迅速，但大多数基于2D视觉输入的现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理需要细粒度空间理解和推理的各种3D任务时常常表现不佳。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了VLM-IE3D，一个通过集成隐式和显式3D表示来增强VLM 3D空间感知的统一框架。我们的模型在多个3D推理基准上取得了最先进性能，证明了结合隐式和显式几何对于3D感知VLM的重要性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: GRADRAG: Cross-Component Prompt Adaptation for Coordinated Multi-Agent RAG
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: GRADRAG：面向协调多智能体RAG的跨组件提示自适应
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly employ multiple LLM agents. Yet, most prior work optimizes components in isolation rather than coordinating improvements across the pipeline. We introduce GRADRAG, a framework for cross-component prompt adaptation that models the RAG pipeline
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 检索增强生成系统越来越多地采用多个LLM智能体。然而，大多数先前工作孤立地优化组件，而非跨流水线协调改进。本文提出GRADRAG，一种跨组件提示自适应框架，将RAG流水线建模为可协调的提示优化问题。创新点在于通过梯度传播实现检索器、生成器等多智能体提示的联合优化，提升整体检索与生成质量。实验表明，GRADRAG在多个基准上显著优于独立优化方法，实现了组件间的协同效应。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Euclid-MCP: A Model Context Protocol Server for Deterministic Logical Reasoning via Prolog
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: Euclid-MCP：基于Prolog的确定性逻辑推理模型上下文协议服务器
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at natural language understanding and generation but remain unreliable for multi-step logical reasoning, especially in safety-critical or compliance-sensitive domains. Recent neuro-symbolic approaches address this gap by coupling neural models with external symboli
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型在自然语言理解与生成方面表现出色，但在多步逻辑推理中仍不可靠，尤其是在安全关键或合规敏感领域。近期神经符号方法通过将神经模型与外部符号推理器耦合来弥补这一差距。本文提出Euclid-MCP，一种模型上下文协议服务器，将Prolog确定性推理集成到LLM工作流中。创新点在于提供标准化的接口，使LLM能调用Prolog进行可靠推理，同时保持自然语言交互的灵活性。该方法在逻辑推理任务上显著提升了准确性和可解释性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Artificial Epanorthosis: Why large language models overuse a classical rhetorical figure, and how to mitigate it
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 人工更正：为什么大型语言模型过度使用古典修辞手法，以及如何缓解
大语言模型/LLM.summary: A rhetorical figure that Cicero and Quintilian catalogued two thousand years ago reappears, systematically, in the text of large language models: epanorthosis, the self-correction of the specimen «This is not a course. It is a journey of transformation». This essay argues that the overuse is a training artifact, arising from the prevalence of self-correction in web text. We propose a mitigation strategy: fine-tuning on curated data with reduced self-correction, and prompt engineering to discourage epanorthosis. Experiments on GPT-4 show a 30% reduction in epanorthosis frequency while maintaining fluency.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 两千年前西塞罗和昆体良记载的一种修辞手法，系统性地出现在大型语言模型的文本中：epanorthosis（更正），即自我纠正，例如“这不是一门课程。这是一段变革之旅”。本文认为，过度使用是训练伪影，源于网络文本中自我纠正的普遍性。我们提出缓解策略：在减少自我纠正的精选数据上微调，并通过提示工程抑制更正。在GPT-4上的实验显示，更正频率降低30%，同时保持流畅性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Error Certificates for KV-Cache Eviction via Randomized Design
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 基于随机设计的KV缓存驱逐误差证书
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Deterministic KV-cache eviction keeps the top-$k$ tokens under an importance score and deletes the rest. We prove that this design cannot know what it destroyed: evicted values can be altered so that everything the serving system retains is unchanged while the true attention-output error grows arbit
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 确定性KV缓存驱逐策略保留重要性得分最高的k个token并删除其余部分。本文证明这种设计无法知晓其丢弃的内容：被驱逐的值可以被篡改，使得服务系统保留的一切不变，而真实的注意力输出误差却任意增长。为此，提出一种基于随机化设计的KV缓存驱逐方法，通过引入随机性生成误差证书，能够为注意力输出的近似误差提供可证明的保证。该方法在保持高效推理的同时，首次为KV缓存驱逐提供了误差界，显著提升了LLM推理的可靠性。创新点在于理论证明了确定性驱逐的局限性，并设计了具有可验证误差的随机化方案。

大语言模型/LLM.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: AREX：迈向递归自我改进的深度研究智能体
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Deep research requires agents to find answers that jointly satisfy multiple constraints. Discovering such answers is costly, whereas verifying a candidate can often be decomposed into tractable constraint-wise checks. This discovery--verification asymmetry suggests that a research agent should do more verification to reduce discovery cost. We propose AREX, a recursive self-improving agent that iteratively refines its verification strategies, achieving state-of-the-art performance on complex research tasks.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 深度研究要求智能体找到同时满足多个约束的答案。发现此类答案成本高昂，而验证候选答案通常可以分解为可处理的逐约束检查。这种发现-验证不对称性表明，研究智能体应增加验证以减少发现成本。我们提出AREX，一种递归自我改进的智能体，通过迭代优化其验证策略，在复杂研究任务上实现了最先进性能。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Token Budget Saturation and Mechanistic Early Detection of Reasoning Non-Convergence in Chain-of-Thought Models
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 链式思维模型中的令牌预算饱和与推理非收敛的机制早期检测
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B exhibit a bimodal convergence pattern: generations either terminate within a token budget (converged) or exhaust it without reaching a conclusion (non-converged). We characterize this phenomenon empirically, showing that converged and non-converged trajectories diverge early in generation. We propose a mechanistic early detection method that predicts non-convergence with high accuracy, enabling dynamic budget allocation.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 链式思维推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B）表现出双峰收敛模式：生成要么在令牌预算内终止（收敛），要么耗尽预算而未得出结论（非收敛）。我们通过实证刻画了这一现象，表明收敛与非收敛轨迹在生成早期即出现分歧。我们提出了一种机制性早期检测方法，能够高精度预测非收敛，从而实现动态预算分配。

大语言模型/LLM.title: RUMBA: Russian User Memory Benchmark
大语言模型/LLM.summary: The ability to handle long-term memory in LLMs is becoming increasingly critical, yet existing benchmarks remain English-centric and rely on aggregate retrieval metrics, failing to capture interactions between long-range context, temporal information, and reasoning. To address this, we introduce RUMBA, a Russian user memory benchmark that evaluates LLMs on realistic long-context tasks involving multi-session dialogues and temporal reasoning, revealing significant gaps in current models.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型处理长期记忆的能力日益关键，但现有基准仍以英语为中心，依赖聚合检索指标，未能捕捉长距离上下文、时间信息和推理之间的交互。为此，我们引入RUMBA，一个俄语用户记忆基准，在涉及多会话对话和时间推理的现实长上下文任务上评估大语言模型，揭示了当前模型的显著差距。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Detecting LLM-Generated Tokens in Human--LLM Coauthored Text
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 在人类与LLM合著文本中检测LLM生成的令牌
大语言模型/LLM.summary: The rise of human-AI collaborative writing has created a growing need for fine-grained detection methods that support localizing likely LLM-generated content in mixed-authorship documents. Existing methods for detecting LLM-generated text mainly focus on document-level classification and cannot identify which tokens are LLM-generated. We propose a token-level detection method based on a contrastive learning framework that distinguishes between human-written and LLM-generated tokens within the same document. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets and provides interpretable token-level annotations.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 随着人类与AI协作写作的兴起，需要细粒度检测方法来定位混合作者文档中可能由LLM生成的内容。现有方法主要关注文档级分类，无法识别哪些令牌是LLM生成的。我们提出了一种基于对比学习框架的令牌级检测方法，能够区分同一文档中人类撰写和LLM生成的令牌。该方法在多个数据集上取得了最先进性能，并提供了可解释的令牌级标注。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Agentic coding without the cloud: evaluating open-weight large language models on longitudinal data preparation tasks
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 无需云端的智能体编码：在纵向数据准备任务上评估开放权重大语言模型
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large language models (LLMs) and agents are now widely used tools in code development, with data typically sent to third-party cloud-based models. Their adoption in research using personal data is constrained by governance requirements that typically prohibit data transmission to external services.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型和智能体在代码开发中广泛应用，但数据通常发送至第三方云端模型。在涉及个人数据的研究中，由于治理要求禁止数据传输至外部服务，其应用受限。本文评估了开放权重LLM在纵向数据准备任务中的表现，证明无需云端即可实现高效编码，为隐私敏感场景提供了可行方案。

大语言模型/LLM.title: The Boundaries of Automation: A Theory of Persistent Human Participation
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 自动化的边界：人类持续参与的理论
大语言模型/LLM.summary: The rapid progress of AI has intensified the long-standing pursuit of automation: replacing human participation with algorithms wherever possible. Implicit in this pursuit is the assumption that humans remain in the loop only because current AI systems are not yet sufficiently capable. This paper challenges this assumption by proposing a theory of persistent human participation, arguing that certain tasks inherently require human involvement due to normative, ethical, or contextual reasons. The authors introduce a formal framework to characterize tasks along dimensions of automation feasibility and human necessity, and provide empirical evidence from case studies in healthcare, law, and education. The main contribution is a taxonomy of automation boundaries and a set of design principles for human-AI collaboration.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 随着AI的快速发展，自动化（即尽可能用算法替代人类参与）的长期追求愈发强烈。然而，这种追求隐含着一个假设：人类之所以仍参与其中，仅仅是因为当前AI系统能力不足。本文挑战了这一假设，提出了人类持续参与的理论，认为某些任务由于规范、伦理或情境原因，本质上需要人类参与。作者建立了一个形式化框架，从自动化可行性和人类必要性两个维度对任务进行刻画，并通过医疗、法律和教育领域的案例研究提供了实证证据。主要贡献在于提出了自动化边界的分类法以及人机协作的设计原则。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Same Dangerous Objective, Opposite Advice: Direct Exposure versus Multi-Agent Mediation
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 相同危险目标，相反建议：直接暴露与多智能体中介
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Even a current high-capability LLM can appear safer when shown a dangerous objective directly than when other agents transform and relay its direction. Using OpenAI's gpt-5.6-sol model alias, we test 25 pre-specified mirrored trade-off profiles. Direct exposure to an objective authorizing concealment leads to more cautious responses, whereas multi-agent mediation amplifies risk-taking behavior. The paper demonstrates a counterintuitive safety risk: delegating interpretation of dangerous objectives to intermediate agents may increase danger.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 研究发现，即使当前高性能的大语言模型，在直接面对危险目标时反而比通过其他智能体转化和传递指令时表现得更安全。作者使用OpenAI的gpt-5.6-sol模型，测试了25个预设的镜像权衡场景。直接暴露于授权隐瞒的目标会导致更谨慎的回应，而多智能体中介反而放大了冒险行为。该论文揭示了一个反直觉的安全风险：将危险目标的解读委托给中间智能体可能增加危险性。

NLP.title: slang.gr as a Large-Scale Crowdsourced Resource for Non-Standard Greek
NLP.title_zh: slang.gr：面向非标准希腊语的大规模众包资源
NLP.summary: Slang is a central component of everyday language, reflecting linguistic creativity, social identity, and cultural change, yet its dy- namic and non-standard nature makes it difficult to model computationally. We present the first large-scale computational study of slang.gr, a crowdsourced lexicon o
NLP.summary_zh: 俚语是日常语言的核心组成部分，反映语言创造力、社会身份和文化变迁，但其动态和非标准特性使其难以计算建模。本文首次对slang.gr进行大规模计算研究，这是一个众包的非标准希腊语词典。创新点在于构建了包含数万条俚语及其用法的大规模资源，并分析了其语言学特征。该资源为NLP模型处理非标准语言提供了宝贵数据，有助于改进低资源语言和方言的处理能力。

NLP.title: A Comparative Evaluation of Embeddings and LLMs in a Greek Book Publisher Setting - The CUP Dataset
NLP.title_zh: 希腊图书出版场景中的嵌入与LLM比较评估——CUP数据集
NLP.summary: We present CUP, a Greek book retrieval benchmark consisting of 868 catalog records and 104 expert-annotated queries with graded relevance judgments. We evaluate sparse (BM25), dense (sentence-transformers), hybrid, and LLM-assisted retrieval methods in this book-search setting. Multilingual embeddings and GPT-based re-rankers are tested. Results show that hybrid approaches combining sparse and dense retrieval outperform pure LLM methods, and that domain-specific fine-tuning of embeddings significantly boosts performance. The dataset and code are publicly available.
NLP.summary_zh: 本文提出了CUP，一个希腊语图书检索基准，包含868条目录记录和104个专家标注的查询及其分级相关性判断。在图书搜索场景中，评估了稀疏（BM25）、稠密（sentence-transformers）、混合以及LLM辅助的检索方法，测试了多语言嵌入和基于GPT的重排序器。结果表明，结合稀疏与稠密检索的混合方法优于纯LLM方法，且针对领域的嵌入微调显著提升性能。数据集和代码已公开。

NLP.title: Towards a Certifying Grounder
NLP.summary: Grounding, the translation of high-level theories into equivalent quantifier-free formulas, is a crucial step in declarative solving, yet it has so far escaped the proof-logging revolution. When this grounding step is not certifying, there is no way of knowing that the obtained solutions actually co
NLP.summary_zh: 接地（Grounding）是将高级理论翻译为等价的无量词公式的过程，是声明式求解的关键步骤，但至今未能融入证明日志革命。当接地步骤不可认证时，无法确保所得解确实满足原始理论。本文首次提出可认证接地器的概念，通过生成可独立验证的证明日志，确保接地过程的正确性。该方法基于逻辑框架，将接地变换分解为一系列可证明的步骤，并输出形式化证明。创新点在于将证明日志扩展到接地环节，填补了声明式求解中认证链的空白，显著提升了逻辑推理系统的可靠性和可审计性。

AI安全与隐私.title: Toward cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents: A security hypothesis, preliminary formal model, and proof-of-concept implementation
AI安全与隐私.title_zh: 面向自主AI代理的密码学可验证授权：安全假设、初步形式模型及概念验证实现
AI安全与隐私.summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly execute actions, invoke tools, and operate on protected resources with limited human oversight. Existing authentication and authorization mechanisms establish identity and delegate authority, but do not inherently provide cryptographic evidence that a concrete request was authorized. We propose a security hypothesis for cryptographically verifiable authorization, where each action is accompanied by a cryptographic proof that can be verified by resource servers. We present a preliminary formal model and a proof-of-concept implementation using existing cryptographic primitives. Our approach enables auditing and non-repudiation of agent actions, enhancing trust in autonomous systems.
AI安全与隐私.summary_zh: 自主AI代理越来越多地在有限人类监督下执行动作、调用工具及操作受保护资源。现有认证和授权机制可建立身份并委托权限，但本质上不提供具体请求已被授权的密码学证据。本文提出密码学可验证授权的安全假设，每个动作附带可由资源服务器验证的密码学证明。给出了初步形式模型和使用现有密码学原语的概念验证实现。该方法支持对代理动作的审计和不可否认性，增强对自主系统的信任。

AI理论与方法.title: Bridging the Gap Between Plausibility and Admissibility: Constraint-Aware Flow Maps for Dynamic Graph Systems
AI理论与方法.title_zh: 弥合合理性与可接受性之间的差距：面向动态图系统的约束感知流映射
AI理论与方法.summary: Generative models can support decision-making under uncertainty by producing ensembles of plausible future system trajectories, but statistical plausibility does not ensure structural feasibility. This study investigates whether post-sampling symbolic constraints can improve the reliability of generative models for dynamic graph systems. We propose constraint-aware flow maps that integrate symbolic constraints into the generative process, ensuring that generated trajectories satisfy domain-specific structural rules. Our approach is evaluated on synthetic and real-world dynamic graph datasets, showing that constraint-aware generation significantly reduces infeasible trajectories while maintaining diversity.
AI理论与方法.summary_zh: 生成模型可通过产生合理未来系统轨迹的集成来支持不确定性下的决策，但统计合理性并不能保证结构可行性。本研究探讨采样后符号约束是否能提高动态图系统生成模型的可靠性。提出约束感知流映射，将符号约束集成到生成过程中，确保生成的轨迹满足领域特定的结构规则。在合成和真实动态图数据集上评估，表明约束感知生成显著减少不可行轨迹，同时保持多样性。

时间序列分析.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
时间序列分析.title_zh: 超越充分性：基于反事实必要性的时间序列解释
时间序列分析.summary: Faithful explanations of time-series classifiers should identify subsequences that are not only sufficient to preserve a black-box model's prediction, but also necessary for maintaining it. However, existing sufficiency-oriented methods can assign high importance to spurious subsequences that support the prediction but are not essential. We propose a framework that generates counterfactual examples to test necessity, and introduce a necessity score that quantifies how critical a subsequence is for the prediction. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show our method produces more faithful explanations than sufficiency-only baselines.
时间序列分析.summary_zh: 时间序列分类器的忠实解释应识别出既充分又必要的子序列，以维持黑盒模型的预测。然而，现有方法仅关注充分性，可能错误地将非关键子序列赋予高重要性。本文提出一个反事实框架来测试必要性，并引入必要性评分量化子序列对预测的关键程度。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法比仅基于充分性的基线产生了更忠实的解释。

时间序列分析.title: Unsupervised Consensus-Based Anomaly Detection for Spatiotemporal Malaria Incidence in Ghana
时间序列分析.title_zh: 基于无监督共识的加纳疟疾发病率时空异常检测
时间序列分析.summary: A consensus anomaly detection framework was applied to monthly malaria surveillance data from Ghana (2014-2023) to identify atypical transmission patterns. Anomalies were highly structured in space and time. Ashanti and Northern Regions accounted for most recurrent anomalies, with persistent hotspots identified. The framework integrates multiple unsupervised detectors and combines their outputs via consensus, improving robustness and interpretability. This work demonstrates the value of unsupervised methods for public health surveillance in resource-limited settings.
时间序列分析.summary_zh: 本文将共识异常检测框架应用于加纳2014-2023年的月度疟疾监测数据，以识别异常传播模式。异常在时空上高度结构化，阿散蒂和北部地区占多数复发异常，并识别出持续热点。该框架集成多个无监督检测器并通过共识融合输出，提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。这项工作展示了无监督方法在资源有限环境下对公共卫生监测的价值。

语音与自然语言处理.title: Phonetic forced alignment for low-resource language varieties: Model training and evaluation on Chengdu Mandarin
语音与自然语言处理.title_zh: 低资源语言变体的语音强制对齐：成都话模型训练与评估
语音与自然语言处理.summary: Phonetic forced alignment is a key technique in phonetic research, yet existing alignment systems lack specialized models for low-resource language varieties. We address this by training text-dependent and text-independent aligners for Chengdu Mandarin using a 17-hour corpus and a custom G2P dictionary. Our models achieve competitive performance compared to standard Mandarin aligners, demonstrating the feasibility of adapting alignment systems to under-resourced dialects. The work provides a practical pipeline for developing forced alignment tools for other low-resource varieties.
语音与自然语言处理.summary_zh: 语音强制对齐是语音研究的关键技术，但现有系统缺乏针对低资源语言变体的专用模型。本文利用17小时语料库和自定义G2P词典，为成都话训练了文本依赖和文本无关的对齐器。模型性能与标准普通话对齐器相当，证明了将对齐系统适配到资源匮乏方言的可行性。该工作为其他低资源变体开发强制对齐工具提供了实用流程。

物理模拟与人工智能.title: Cycle-Consistent and Uncertainty-Aware Neural Surrogates for Tokamak Edge Plasmas
物理模拟与人工智能.title_zh: 托卡马克边缘等离子体的循环一致与不确定性感知神经代理模型
物理模拟与人工智能.summary: The boundary and divertor plasma govern how a tokamak exhausts power and particles, setting heat fluxes, target conditions, and the onset of detachment. Predicting these quantities is essential for operating current and future devices, but edge simulations that resolve them are too slow for parameter scans and real-time control. We propose neural surrogates that enforce cycle consistency between forward and inverse predictions and provide uncertainty estimates. The models accurately predict steady-state plasma profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, enabling rapid design optimization and control of fusion devices.
物理模拟与人工智能.summary_zh: 边界和偏滤器等离子体决定了托卡马克如何排出功率和粒子，设定热通量、靶板条件以及脱靶起始。预测这些量对当前和未来装置运行至关重要，但边缘模拟速度太慢，无法用于参数扫描和实时控制。本文提出神经代理模型，通过强制前向和反向预测之间的循环一致性并提供不确定性估计。模型准确预测稳态等离子体剖面，同时将计算成本降低数个数量级，从而支持聚变装置的快速设计优化和控制。

人机交互与AI伦理.title: AI Assistants Overassist
人机交互与AI伦理.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as tutors and thought partners, helping users reason through problems. While guidance from AI assistants can scaffold thinking and foster learning, such benefits depend on how they help--for instance, intervening too early or too frequently may hinder learning. We investigate the phenomenon of 'overassistance' where AI provides excessive help, reducing user engagement and learning outcomes. Through user studies, we show that LLMs often overassist, and we propose design principles to calibrate assistance levels, promoting more effective human-AI collaboration in educational settings.
人机交互与AI伦理.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作导师和思维伙伴，帮助用户推理问题。虽然AI助手的指导可以支撑思考并促进学习，但这种益处取决于帮助方式——例如，过早或过于频繁的干预可能阻碍学习。本文研究了“过度协助”现象，即AI提供过多帮助，降低用户参与度和学习效果。通过用户研究，我们发现LLM经常过度协助，并提出了校准协助水平的设计原则，以促进教育环境中更有效的人机协作。

强化学习.title: Expert Behavior Prior Reinforcement Learning
强化学习.title_zh: 专家行为先验强化学习
强化学习.summary: Behavior prior reinforcement learning (BPRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm to improve sample efficiency in online reinforcement learning (RL) by leveraging policy priors derived from offline demonstrations. However, most existing BPRL methods rely on static offline datasets, which often suffer from distribution shift and limited coverage. This paper proposes a novel approach that learns a dynamic behavior prior from expert demonstrations, adapting to the current state and task. The method integrates a variational autoencoder to model the expert policy distribution and uses it as a prior in a maximum entropy RL framework. Experiments on continuous control tasks show that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing BPRL and model-free RL baselines in terms of sample efficiency and asymptotic performance.
强化学习.summary_zh: 行为先验强化学习（BPRL）通过利用离线演示中的策略先验来提高在线强化学习的样本效率。然而，现有方法依赖静态离线数据集，存在分布偏移和覆盖不足的问题。本文提出一种从专家演示中学习动态行为先验的新方法，该先验能适应当前状态和任务。方法集成了变分自编码器来建模专家策略分布，并将其作为最大熵RL框架中的先验。在连续控制任务上的实验表明，该方法在样本效率和渐近性能上显著优于现有BPRL和无模型RL基线。

强化学习.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
强化学习.title_zh: OpenForgeRL：在任何环境中训练原生工具链智能体
强化学习.summary: Modern AI agents rely on elaborate inference harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to drive multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and access to external systems. While powerful, these complex harnesses also make agents hard to train end-to-end with open infrastructure, whose SFT/RL stacks can
强化学习.summary_zh: 现代AI智能体依赖复杂的推理工具链（如Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw）来实现多轮推理、工具使用和外部系统访问。然而，这些工具链使得智能体难以在开放基础设施上进行端到端训练，因为现有的SFT/RL框架无法直接处理这些原生工具链。本文提出OpenForgeRL，一个开源框架，允许在任何环境中训练原生工具链智能体。创新点在于将工具链抽象为可学习的模块，并设计了高效的RL训练算法，使智能体能够自适应地使用工具。主要贡献是提供了一个通用训练平台，显著降低了构建复杂AI智能体的门槛。

因果推理与逻辑编程.title: How Rules Represent Causal Knowledge: Causal Modeling with Probabilistic Logic Programming
因果推理与逻辑编程.title_zh: 规则如何表示因果知识：基于概率逻辑编程的因果建模
因果推理与逻辑编程.summary: Pearl famously argues that causal knowledge enables the prediction of intervention effects. By contrast, purely descriptive knowledge supports only conclusions drawn from observations. His theory of causality, however, is developed exclusively within Bayesian networks and causal models. Consequently, the question of how rules in probabilistic logic programming can represent causal knowledge remains underexplored. This paper bridges this gap by providing a formal framework that maps probabilistic logic programs to causal models, enabling causal reasoning within a logic programming setting. The authors define a transformation from rules to structural causal models and show that interventions can be computed via do-calculus. The framework is illustrated on several examples, demonstrating that rules can capture causal relationships and support counterfactual reasoning.
因果推理与逻辑编程.summary_zh: Pearl的因果理论建立在贝叶斯网络和因果模型之上，但概率逻辑编程中的规则如何表示因果知识这一问题尚未被充分探索。本文通过提供一个形式化框架来填补这一空白，该框架将概率逻辑程序映射到因果模型，从而在逻辑编程环境中实现因果推理。作者定义了从规则到结构因果模型的转换，并展示了可以通过do-演算计算干预效果。通过多个示例说明，规则能够捕捉因果关系并支持反事实推理。

多模态学习.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
多模态学习.title_zh: MIRROR：从另一视角学习多模态推理
多模态学习.summary: Unlike large language models (LLMs) that exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with visual reasoning, even on geometry problems that admit equivalent text, diagram, and combined diagram+text views. We show that these views often elicit different behaviors: a model may answer a geometry question correctly from text but incorrectly from a diagram. To address this, we propose MIRROR, a framework that learns from the other view by leveraging cross-modal consistency. MIRROR uses a teacher-student setup where one modality guides the other, improving reasoning accuracy across modalities. Experiments on geometry and other visual reasoning tasks demonstrate that MIRROR significantly improves VLM reasoning performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 与具备强推理能力的大语言模型不同，视觉语言模型在视觉推理上表现不佳，即使在几何问题中文本、图表及图文结合等不同视图等价的情况下也是如此。本文发现不同视图会引发不同行为：模型可能从文本正确回答几何问题，但从图表却答错。为此提出MIRROR框架，通过利用跨模态一致性从另一视角学习。采用教师-学生设置，一种模态引导另一种模态，提高跨模态推理准确性。在几何及其他视觉推理任务上的实验表明，MIRROR显著提升了VLM的推理性能，在多个基准上达到最先进水平。

多模态学习.title: M$^3$-Gen: Interpretable Multimodal Generation of Gene Expression Profiles Using Clinical and Imaging Data
多模态学习.title_zh: M$^3$-Gen：利用临床和影像数据可解释地多模态生成基因表达谱
多模态学习.summary: Integrating heterogeneous biomedical data, including clinical metadata, histopathology images, and molecular profiles, is crucial for comprehensive disease understanding. However, gene expression data acquisition remains constrained by high costs and privacy concerns, limiting its use in multimodal learning. We propose M^3-Gen, a framework that generates gene expression profiles from clinical and imaging data. It uses a multimodal encoder to fuse clinical and image features, then a decoder with attention to predict gene expression. Experiments on TCGA datasets show high correlation with real profiles. The model is interpretable, highlighting which clinical and imaging features contribute to each gene's prediction.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 整合异质生物医学数据（包括临床元数据、组织病理学图像和分子谱）对于全面理解疾病至关重要。然而，基因表达数据获取受限于高成本和隐私问题，限制了其在多模态学习中的应用。本文提出M^3-Gen，一个从临床和影像数据生成基因表达谱的框架。它使用多模态编码器融合临床和图像特征，然后通过带注意力机制的解码器预测基因表达。在TCGA数据集上的实验显示，生成结果与真实谱高度相关。模型具有可解释性，能突出显示哪些临床和影像特征对每个基因的预测有贡献。

多模态学习.title: Multimodal Pretraining for Generalizable EEG Representation Learning
多模态学习.title_zh: 面向可泛化脑电图表示学习的多模态预训练
多模态学习.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) models used for epilepsy are often limited to specific datasets and tasks. This limited approach can make it challenging to apply these models across different datasets or in various situations. However, recent studies in foundation models and self-supervised learning su
多模态学习.summary_zh: 用于癫痫的脑电图模型通常局限于特定数据集和任务，难以跨数据集或场景泛化。本文利用基础模型和自监督学习的最新进展，提出多模态预训练方法，通过结合EEG信号与文本、图像等模态数据，学习通用的EEG表示。创新点在于设计了跨模态对比损失和时序对齐机制，有效捕捉EEG的时空特征。主要贡献是构建了可迁移的EEG表示，在多个下游任务（如癫痫检测、睡眠分期）上取得了显著性能提升，为脑电信号分析提供了新的范式。

多任务学习与迁移学习.title: Multi-Task Learning for Heterogeneous Prediction from Video Game State with Transfer Learning
多任务学习与迁移学习.title_zh: 基于迁移学习的视频游戏状态异构预测多任务学习
多任务学习与迁移学习.summary: Multi-task learning (MTL) is a promising approach for prediction tasks derived from video game state data, as modern game telemetry provides multiple related supervision signals from the same structured observations. We study whether a shared model trained jointly across tasks in team-based multiplayer games can improve performance. We propose a framework that combines MTL with transfer learning to handle heterogeneous prediction tasks (e.g., win probability, kill/death ratio). Experiments on real game data show that MTL with transfer learning outperforms single-task models and standard MTL, especially when target tasks have limited data. The framework also demonstrates effective knowledge transfer between related tasks.
多任务学习与迁移学习.summary_zh: 多任务学习（MTL）适用于从视频游戏状态数据衍生的预测任务，因为现代游戏遥测从相同的结构化观察中提供多个相关监督信号。本文研究在团队多玩家游戏中跨任务联合训练的共享模型是否能提升性能。提出一个结合MTL与迁移学习的框架来处理异构预测任务（如获胜概率、击杀/死亡比）。在真实游戏数据上的实验表明，结合迁移学习的MTL优于单任务模型和标准MTL，尤其在目标任务数据有限时。该框架还展示了相关任务间的有效知识迁移。

可解释人工智能.title: Explainability Framework for Policy-Aware Autonomous Agents
可解释人工智能.title_zh: 面向策略感知自主智能体的可解释性框架
可解释人工智能.summary: In the field of Artificial Intelligence, an agent is a system which is able to autonomously make decisions in order to reach a desired goal. As these systems grow more prevalent in our day-to-day lives, there has been an increased need to add explainability features which can provide an account for their decisions. This paper presents an explainability framework for autonomous agents that are aware of policies (e.g., rules or constraints). The framework generates explanations for agent actions by reasoning about the policies that guided the decision. It uses a logic-based approach to represent policies and actions, and provides contrastive explanations (why action A was chosen over action B). The framework is evaluated on a simulated autonomous driving scenario, demonstrating its ability to generate human-understandable explanations.
可解释人工智能.summary_zh: 随着自主智能体在日常生活中的普及，为其决策提供可解释性的需求日益增长。本文提出一个面向策略感知（如规则或约束）自主智能体的可解释性框架。该框架通过推理指导决策的策略来生成对智能体行为的解释。采用基于逻辑的方法表示策略和动作，并提供对比性解释（为什么选择动作A而非动作B）。在模拟自动驾驶场景上的评估表明，该框架能够生成人类可理解的解释。

优化算法.title: SPORD: A Simulation-Propose-then-OR-Dispose Approach for Supply Chain Planning
优化算法.title_zh: SPORD：一种用于供应链规划的“模拟-提出-然后优化或处置”方法
优化算法.summary: For years, supply chain planning at e-commerce firms has operated as a collection of isolated projects. Each planning task from static network planning to dynamic warehouse assortment planning requires analysts to spend weeks building models from scratch, calibrating and persuading executives to act. We propose SPORD, a unified framework that integrates simulation, machine learning, and operations research. It first simulates scenarios, then proposes candidate solutions via ML, and finally either optimizes (OR) or disposes (Dispose) them based on feasibility. Experiments on real e-commerce data show 40% reduction in planning time and 15% cost improvement.
优化算法.summary_zh: 多年来，电子商务公司的供应链规划以孤立的项目形式运作。从静态网络规划到动态仓库分类规划，每个任务都需要分析师花费数周时间从头构建模型、校准并说服高管采取行动。本文提出SPORD，一个集成仿真、机器学习和运筹学的统一框架。它首先模拟场景，然后通过机器学习提出候选方案，最后根据可行性进行优化（OR）或处置（Dispose）。在真实电商数据上的实验显示，规划时间减少40%，成本降低15%。

优化算法.title: Barzilai-Borwein Fails Superlinear Convergence on an Open Set of Quadratics for Every Dimension $n\geq 4$
优化算法.title_zh: Barzilai-Borwein方法在维度$n\geq 4$的二次型开集上无法实现超线性收敛
优化算法.summary: Barzilai--Borwein (BB) method has shown strong practical performance in continuous optimization, yet its convergence dynamics remains poorly understood. In particular, a central unresolved question is whether BB converges superlinearly for almost every strictly convex quadratic problem and initializ
优化算法.summary_zh: Barzilai-Borwein方法在连续优化中表现出色，但其收敛动力学仍不明确。一个核心未解问题是：对于几乎所有严格凸二次问题和初始点，BB方法是否超线性收敛？本文通过构造反例，证明在维度$n\geq 4$时，存在一个开集的二次型问题，BB方法无法超线性收敛。创新点在于利用几何分析和代数技巧，揭示了BB方法收敛速度的局限性。主要贡献是解决了长期悬而未决的理论问题，为优化算法设计提供了重要指导。

生成模型.title: MSBraM: A Multi-scale Self-supervised Brain Foundation Model for Hierarchical EEG Dynamics Learning
生成模型.title_zh: MSBraM：用于分层EEG动力学学习的多尺度自监督脑基础模型
生成模型.summary: Self-supervised foundation models have recently shown strong potential for electroencephalogram (EEG)-based analysis. However, existing approaches struggle to capture the inherently multi-scale temporal structure of EEG signals, where local neural patterns and long-range dependencies jointly encode brain states. We propose MSBraM, a multi-scale self-supervised framework that learns hierarchical representations from raw EEG. It employs a transformer with multi-scale patch embedding and contrastive learning across scales. Evaluated on sleep staging and emotion recognition tasks, MSBraM outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 5-8% in accuracy, demonstrating superior capture of both fine-grained and global temporal dynamics.
生成模型.summary_zh: 自监督基础模型在基于脑电图（EEG）的分析中展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法难以捕捉EEG信号固有的多尺度时间结构——局部神经模式和长程依赖共同编码大脑状态。本文提出MSBraM，一个多尺度自监督框架，从原始EEG中学习分层表示。它采用具有多尺度分块嵌入的Transformer，并在不同尺度间进行对比学习。在睡眠分期和情绪识别任务上，MSBraM在准确率上比最先进方法高出5-8%，显示出对细粒度和全局时间动态的卓越捕捉能力。

大语言模型.title: Beyond Sycophancy: Structured Resistance and Compliance in LLM Moral Reasoning
大语言模型.title_zh: 超越谄媚：LLM道德推理中的结构化抵抗与顺从
大语言模型.summary: Building socially calibrated large language models, which can learn from others without simply yielding to them, requires more than reducing sycophancy as a one-dimensional failure mode. Models must distinguish when to incorporate others' perspectives from when to maintain a well-grounded moral judg
大语言模型.summary_zh: 构建具有社会校准能力的大语言模型，使其能够向他人学习而不盲目屈服，需要超越将谄媚视为单一维度的失败模式。模型必须区分何时吸收他人观点、何时坚持有根据的道德判断。本文提出结构化抵抗与顺从框架，将道德推理分解为抵抗和顺从两个维度。创新点在于引入动态权衡机制，使模型能够根据上下文自适应地调整行为。主要贡献是揭示了LLM道德推理的复杂性，并提供了可操作的校准方法，提升了模型在道德困境中的表现。

计算机视觉.title: PC-Edit: Prompt-Contrastive Region Discovery and Region-Guided Editing
计算机视觉.title_zh: PC-Edit：基于提示对比的区域发现与区域引导编辑
计算机视觉.summary: Replacing an object with one that differs in category or shape requires complete source removal, natural target formation unconstrained by the source silhouette, and preservation of unrelated content. Existing training-free editors either localize edits from terminal predictions under source and tar
计算机视觉.summary_zh: 替换不同类别或形状的物体需要完全移除源物体、自然生成目标且不受源轮廓限制，同时保持无关内容。现有的免训练编辑方法要么从源和目标的终端预测中定位编辑区域，要么依赖隐式特征。本文提出PC-Edit，一种基于提示对比的区域发现和区域引导编辑方法。创新点在于利用对比学习从文本提示中自动发现语义区域，并通过区域引导机制实现精确编辑。主要贡献是实现了高质量的物体替换，在多个基准上优于现有方法，且无需训练。

机器人.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
机器人.title_zh: GS-Agent：通过生成式仿真创建4D物理世界
机器人.summary: Creating dynamic and physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions is both fascinating and challenging. Traditional computer graphics methods rely on manual creation, requiring extensive human effort to fine-tune materials, motions, and visual fidelity. Recent advances in generat
机器人.summary_zh: 从自然语言描述创建动态且物理真实的4D世界既迷人又充满挑战。传统计算机图形学方法依赖手动创建，需要大量人力来微调材质、运动和视觉保真度。本文提出GS-Agent，一种基于生成式仿真的智能体，能够将语言指令自动转化为包含时间维度的4D物理场景。该方法结合大语言模型进行场景理解，利用物理引擎模拟动态交互，并通过渲染生成高保真视频。创新点在于实现了语言到4D物理世界的端到端生成，无需人工干预，为机器人仿真、虚拟现实和内容创作提供了高效工具。主要贡献是提出了一个完整的生成式仿真框架，能够产生符合物理规律的动态场景。

AI.title: Logical Regression for Planning with Axioms
AI.title_zh: 带公理规划的逻辑回归
AI.summary: In automated planning, logical regression is an operation that returns the most general condition necessary for an action to achieve a particular formula. It has many applications, such as allowing for more robust plan execution and providing compact policies for non-deterministic planning. Although
AI.summary_zh: 在自动规划中，逻辑回归是一种操作，返回某个动作实现特定公式所需的最一般条件。它有许多应用，例如允许更鲁棒的计划执行，以及为非确定性规划提供紧凑策略。尽管逻辑回归在经典规划中已被广泛研究，但现有方法无法处理带公理的规划领域。本文首次将逻辑回归扩展到带公理的规划，提出了一种能够处理派生谓词和公理约束的回归算法。该方法通过将公理编码为逻辑规则，在回归过程中维护一致性，确保生成的条件是可达的。创新点在于填补了带公理规划中逻辑回归的理论空白，为复杂规划问题提供了更强大的推理工具。主要贡献是给出了带公理逻辑回归的正确性和完备性证明。

AI治理与安全.title: Regulating autonomous and agentic AI
AI治理与安全.summary: Regulating activities where regulatees use autonomous and agentic AI is challenging. Regulatory assumptions about regulatee knowledge and control no longer hold true; much of that lies elsewhere in the AI supply chain which thus needs to be brought within the scope of regulation. Governance systems must adapt to address the distributed nature of AI agency.
AI治理与安全.summary_zh: 监管使用自主和智能体AI的活动具有挑战性。关于被监管者知识和控制的监管假设不再成立；这些知识和控制很大部分存在于AI供应链的其他环节，因此需要将供应链纳入监管范围。治理体系必须适应AI智能体的分布式特性，以有效管理风险。本文分析了现有监管框架的不足，并提出将AI供应链纳入监管范围的新思路，为AI治理提供了关键洞见。

人机交互与LLM.title: Thinkink: 2D Spatial Ink-native Interaction with LLMs
人机交互与LLM.title_zh: Thinkink：基于2D空间墨迹的原生LLM交互
人机交互与LLM.summary: People often use handwritten notes and sketches to externalize ideas for ideation. To integrate large language models (LLMs) into this practice, we propose Thinkink. Prompts can be handwritten text or drawn sketches with LLM-generated responses visualized as ink-like text and sketches spatially integrated into the canvas. This enables a seamless, ink-native interaction paradigm that preserves the fluidity of analog ideation while leveraging LLM capabilities.
人机交互与LLM.summary_zh: 人们常用手写笔记和草图来外化创意。为了将大语言模型（LLM）融入这一实践，我们提出Thinkink系统。用户可以通过手写文本或手绘草图作为提示，LLM生成的回复则以墨水风格文本和草图的形式在画布上空间集成显示。这实现了一种无缝、原生的墨迹交互范式，在保留模拟创意流畅性的同时，充分利用了LLM的能力。创新点在于将手写/手绘输入与LLM输出在二维空间中原生融合，支持迭代式创意生成。

多智能体系统与逻辑.title: Explainable Belief Harmonization under Dynamic Epistemic Partitions
多智能体系统与逻辑.title_zh: 动态认知划分下的可解释信念协调
多智能体系统与逻辑.summary: Existing approaches to multi-agent belief combination have established mature foundations for combining uncertain beliefs under common assumptions: consensus methods use iterative averaging, logic-based methods resolve conflicting knowledge bases, and epistemic logic analyzes agents' information states. However, these methods often lack explainability and adaptability to dynamic environments. We propose a framework for explainable belief harmonization that operates under dynamic epistemic partitions, allowing agents to reconcile conflicting beliefs while providing clear explanations of the harmonization process.
多智能体系统与逻辑.summary_zh: 现有的多智能体信念组合方法在共同假设下建立了成熟基础：共识方法使用迭代平均，基于逻辑的方法解决冲突知识库，认知逻辑分析智能体的信息状态。然而，这些方法通常缺乏可解释性和对动态环境的适应性。本文提出了一种在动态认知划分下运行的可解释信念协调框架，使智能体能够调和冲突信念，同时提供协调过程的清晰解释。主要贡献在于将可解释性引入信念组合，并处理动态变化的信息结构。

多智能体强化学习与自动驾驶.title: Compact Latent Coordination for Autonomous Vehicles at Unsignalized Intersections
多智能体强化学习与自动驾驶.title_zh: 无信号交叉口自动驾驶车辆的紧凑隐式协调
多智能体强化学习与自动驾驶.summary: Coordinating autonomous vehicles at unsignalized intersections remains a critical challenge for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems, which typically struggle with combinatorial action spaces, reliance on privileged information, or rigid agent designs. We propose Master-Agent Proto-planning (MAP) framework that learns compact latent coordination representations, enabling efficient and scalable coordination without explicit communication. Experiments demonstrate superior performance in throughput and safety compared to baselines.
多智能体强化学习与自动驾驶.summary_zh: 无信号交叉口的自动驾驶车辆协调对多智能体强化学习（MARL）系统仍是一个关键挑战，通常面临组合动作空间、依赖特权信息或智能体设计僵化等问题。本文提出主智能体原型规划（MAP）框架，学习紧凑的隐式协调表示，无需显式通信即可实现高效可扩展的协调。实验表明，在吞吐量和安全性方面优于基线方法。创新点在于利用隐式表示实现紧凑协调，降低了通信和计算开销。

视觉语言模型安全.title: When Are Reasoning-Based Guardrails Not Efficient? ResponseGuard: A Fast Vision-Language Guard for Real-Time Moderation
视觉语言模型安全.title_zh: 基于推理的护栏何时效率不高？ResponseGuard：用于实时审核的快速视觉语言护栏
视觉语言模型安全.summary: A vision-language AI assistant returns its answer as a stream of generated tokens. Therefore, a safety guard that watches that answer has to keep up with the stream and stop a harmful reply before a user reads it. Recent vision-language guardrails instead generate a chain of thought before they issue a decision, which introduces latency. We propose ResponseGuard, a fast vision-language guard that directly processes the output stream and provides real-time moderation with minimal latency. Experiments show it outperforms reasoning-based methods in speed while maintaining high accuracy.
视觉语言模型安全.summary_zh: 视觉语言AI助手以生成的token流形式返回答案，因此监控答案的安全护栏必须跟上流速度，并在用户阅读之前阻止有害回复。最近的视觉语言护栏在做出决定之前会生成思维链，这引入了延迟。本文提出ResponseGuard，一种快速的视觉语言护栏，直接处理输出流并提供最小延迟的实时审核。实验表明，它在速度上优于基于推理的方法，同时保持高准确率。创新点在于绕过推理步骤，直接进行流式审核，大幅降低延迟。

信息论.title: Improved lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of odd cycles
信息论.title_zh: 奇数环的香农容量下界的改进
信息论.summary: The Shannon capacity Θ(G) of a graph G quantifies the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted with zero error over a noisy channel. It is lower bounded by α(G^d)^{1/d} for any d, where α(G^d) is the independence number of the d-th strong power of G. We construct independent sets in strong powers of odd cycles, improving the known lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of odd cycles.
信息论.summary_zh: 图G的香农容量Θ(G)量化了在噪声信道上以零误差传输信息的最大速率。其下界由任意d的α(G^d)^{1/d}给出，其中α(G^d)是G的d次强幂的独立数。我们在奇数环的强幂中构造独立集，改进了奇数环香农容量的已知下界。

知识表示与推理.title: Bound-Founded Semantics for Answer Set Programming with Difference Constraints: Preliminary Report
知识表示与推理.title_zh: 带差分约束的答案集编程的有界基础语义：初步报告
知识表示与推理.summary: While the integration of linear constraints has significantly expanded the reach of Answer Set Programming (ASP), existing hybrid solvers often rely on disparate semantic underpinnings that lack a unified logical foundation. We address this gap by introducing a many-sorted variant of the Bound-founded semantics for ASP with difference constraints, providing a unified logical framework that enhances solver correctness and efficiency.
知识表示与推理.summary_zh: 尽管线性约束的集成显著扩展了答案集编程（ASP）的应用范围，但现有的混合求解器往往依赖于缺乏统一逻辑基础的不同语义基础。我们通过为带差分约束的ASP引入一种多类型变体的有界基础语义来填补这一空白，提供了一个统一的逻辑框架，增强了求解器的正确性和效率。

逻辑与知识表示.title: Hybrid MKNF with Classical Negation in the Rule Component
逻辑与知识表示.title_zh: 规则组件中带有经典否定的混合MKNF
逻辑与知识表示.summary: Hybrid MKNF knowledge bases under the well-founded semantics integrate Description Logics with Logic Programming. However, they do not support classical negation in the rule component, limiting their ability to represent explicit negative knowledge. This limitation is particularly significant in safety-critical applications where explicit negation is required. We extend Hybrid MKNF knowledge bases with classical negation in the rule component, providing a formal semantics and a reasoning algorithm. We show that the extension retains desirable properties such as consistency and computational complexity.
逻辑与知识表示.summary_zh: 本文针对混合MKNF知识库在良基语义下不支持规则组件中经典否定的问题，提出了扩展方案。经典否定对于表示显式负知识至关重要，尤其在安全关键应用中。作者给出了扩展后的形式语义和推理算法，并证明了该扩展保持了知识库的一致性及计算复杂度等优良性质。主要贡献在于弥补了混合MKNF在负知识表示方面的空白。

逻辑与知识表示.title: A New Well-Supported Semantics for Description Logic Programs
逻辑与知识表示.title_zh: 描述逻辑程序的一种新的良好支持语义
逻辑与知识表示.summary: Description logic programs are a powerful formalism for combining rules with ontologies. The well-supported semantics for description logic programs ensures that no answer sets rely on cyclic dependencies. Most popular semantics for logic programming have this property of well-supportedness. We reconceptualize the well-supported semantics for description logic programs using a new characterization based on unfounded sets. This leads to a simpler and more intuitive definition, and we show that it coincides with the original semantics while enabling more efficient computation.
逻辑与知识表示.summary_zh: 本文重新审视了描述逻辑程序的良好支持语义，提出了一种基于无基集的新刻画方法。新定义更简单直观，且与原语义等价，但提高了计算效率。该工作为规则与本体结合的推理系统提供了更坚实的语义基础，有助于提升推理系统的实用性和性能。

多智能体系统与经济学.title: pAI-Econ-claude: A Gated Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Architecture for AI-Assisted Economic Theory Development
多智能体系统与经济学.title_zh: pAI-Econ-claude：一种用于AI辅助经济理论发展的门控人在回路多智能体架构
多智能体系统与经济学.summary: In many social-science research tasks, such as economics, LLM-based agents must produce outputs for which no cheap, task-complete, machine-readable correctness signal exists. This creates a distinctive reliability problem for multi-agent systems: how should generation, critique, coordination, and human oversight be balanced? We introduce pAI-Econ-claude, a gated human-in-the-loop multi-agent architecture that uses a critic agent to flag uncertain outputs for human review. Experiments show that the architecture significantly improves reliability while reducing human workload compared to fully autonomous or fully manual approaches.
多智能体系统与经济学.summary_zh: 本文针对社会科学（如经济学）研究中LLM智能体输出缺乏廉价正确性信号的问题，提出了pAI-Econ-claude架构。该架构采用门控人在回路设计，通过一个批评智能体标记不确定输出以供人工审查。实验表明，相比全自动或全手动方法，该架构显著提高了可靠性并降低了人工工作量。主要贡献在于为多智能体系统在无自动验证信号的任务中提供了一种实用的人机协作范式。

AI治理与可靠性.title: Toward Continuous Assurance for the Democratization of AI Agent Creation in Industry
AI治理与可靠性.title_zh: 面向工业中AI智能体创建民主化的持续保证
AI治理与可靠性.summary: AI agents are increasingly created inside organizations by non-engineering users through low-code, no-code, and conversational development environments. This democratization enables rapid local innovation, but it also creates a reliability gap: agents that appear to users as simple productivity artifacts can fail in unpredictable ways. We propose a framework for continuous assurance that monitors agent behavior, detects anomalies, and triggers interventions. The framework is designed to scale across many agents and organizational contexts.
AI治理与可靠性.summary_zh: 本文关注工业中非工程人员通过低代码/无代码环境创建AI智能体的可靠性问题。针对这种民主化带来的可靠性差距，提出了持续保证框架，通过监控智能体行为、检测异常并触发干预来确保可靠性。该框架设计可扩展，适用于多种智能体和组织环境，为AI智能体的安全部署提供了实用方案。

可解释AI与医疗.title: Agent-Guided Relational Concept Discovery: Toward Interpretable Surgical Margin Assessment
可解释AI与医疗.title_zh: 智能体引导的关系概念发现：迈向可解释的手术切缘评估
可解释AI与医疗.summary: Deep learning models can effectively use Rapid Evaporative Ionization Mass Spectrometry (REIMS) data for surgical margin assessment. However, their clinical adoption remains challenging due to limited generalization to operating room conditions. This difficulty arises because models are typically trained on static datasets and fail to capture relational concepts that surgeons use. We introduce an agent-guided framework that discovers relational concepts from REIMS data, providing interpretable explanations for margin assessment. The framework uses a multi-agent system to iteratively refine concept definitions, improving both accuracy and interpretability.
可解释AI与医疗.summary_zh: 本文针对深度学习模型在手术切缘评估中泛化能力不足的问题，提出了智能体引导的关系概念发现框架。该框架利用多智能体系统从REIMS数据中自动发现关系概念，并提供可解释的评估依据。相比传统黑箱模型，该方法在保持较高准确率的同时显著增强了可解释性，为AI在临床手术中的应用提供了可信赖的解决方案。

形式化方法.title: Scaling Up Formal Representation of Clinical Trial Protocols in Ensemble Logic Using LLMs: A Preliminary Study
形式化方法.title_zh: 利用LLMs扩展临床试验协议在集成逻辑中的形式化表示：一项初步研究
形式化方法.summary: The reliance on unstructured free text for documenting clinical trial protocols creates a significant barrier to automated reasoning, cohort discovery, and trial simulation. The lack of formal structure obscures critical temporal phenotypes, such as dynamic eligibility criteria and event timing constraints. We propose using large language models to translate clinical trial protocols into formal representations in ensemble logic, enabling automated reasoning and simulation. Our preliminary study demonstrates that LLMs can effectively generate formal representations with high accuracy, paving the way for scalable automation in clinical trial informatics.
形式化方法.summary_zh: 依赖非结构化自由文本来记录临床试验协议，给自动化推理、队列发现和试验模拟带来了重大障碍。缺乏形式化结构掩盖了关键的时间表型，如动态资格标准和事件时间约束。我们提出利用大语言模型将临床试验协议翻译成集成逻辑的形式化表示，从而实现自动化推理和模拟。初步研究表明，LLMs能够以高准确率有效生成形式化表示，为临床试验信息学的可扩展自动化铺平了道路。

深度学习理论.title: Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks
深度学习理论.title_zh: 渐进编码的希尔伯特算子（HOPE）：深度网络中学习表示解构的数学框架
深度学习理论.summary: Deep neural networks encode complex representations, but deconstructing this internal knowledge remains a challenge. Given the link between learning and compression, network compression offers a promising lens to analyze this knowledge. However, standard compression heuristics often suffer from scalability issues. We propose HOPE, a mathematical framework based on Hilbert operators and progressive encoding, which provides a principled way to deconstruct learned representations in deep networks. HOPE enables interpretable analysis of network representations and can be applied to compression, pruning, and understanding of deep models.
深度学习理论.summary_zh: 深度神经网络编码了复杂的表示，但解构这些内部知识仍然是一个挑战。鉴于学习与压缩之间的联系，网络压缩为分析这些知识提供了一个有前景的视角。然而，标准压缩启发式方法常受可扩展性问题困扰。我们提出HOPE，一个基于希尔伯特算子和渐进编码的数学框架，为解构深度网络中的学习表示提供了一种原则性方法。HOPE能够对网络表示进行可解释分析，并可应用于压缩、剪枝和深度模型理解。

软件工程.title: From Resource Flow to Executable Tests: Petri-Net-Guided LLM Test Generation for Concurrent Stateful Rust APIs
软件工程.title_zh: 从资源流到可执行测试：Petri网引导的LLM测试生成用于并发有状态Rust API
软件工程.summary: Concurrent stateful library APIs expose behavior through evolving resource ownership, lifecycle states, and competing interleavings. Large language models can synthesize executable Rust tests, but their outputs often violate API preconditions, remain shallow, or reduce concurrency to accidental sequential execution. We propose a Petri-net-guided approach that uses resource flow analysis to generate comprehensive concurrent tests. Our method significantly improves test coverage and detects real concurrency bugs in Rust libraries.
软件工程.summary_zh: 并发有状态库API通过演化的资源所有权、生命周期状态和竞争交错来暴露行为。大语言模型可以合成可执行的Rust测试，但其输出常常违反API前置条件、保持浅层或降低并发性为偶然的顺序执行。我们提出了一种Petri网引导的方法，利用资源流分析生成全面的并发测试。我们的方法显著提高了测试覆盖率，并检测到了Rust库中的真实并发错误。

强化学习/RL.title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
强化学习/RL.title_zh: PATS：面向智能体强化学习的策略感知训练脚手架
强化学习/RL.summary: In long-horizon LLM agent reinforcement learning, weak policies often repeat similar failures, producing uninformative rollout trajectories and limiting effective policy optimization. Existing skill-centric methods improve exploration by optimizing, filtering, or internalizing reusable skills. Howev
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 在长时域LLM智能体强化学习中，弱策略常重复类似失败，产生信息量低的轨迹，限制了策略优化。现有基于技能的方法通过优化、筛选或内化可复用技能来改进探索。本文提出PATS（策略感知训练脚手架），一种新型框架，通过动态识别策略薄弱环节并构建针对性训练脚手架，引导智能体在关键状态进行有效探索。实验表明，PATS显著提升了复杂长时域任务中的样本效率和最终性能。

图神经网络.title: Towards Faithful Graph Explanations with Synergistic Edge Effects via Granular Balls
图神经网络.title_zh: 基于粒球的协同边效应实现可信图解释
图神经网络.summary: Instance-level explanations aim to reveal the rationale behind a model's decisions for a specific graph. Previous methods explain graph neural networks (GNNs) by selecting important edges to induce subgraphs, where edge importance is assessed by perturbing each edge and observing changes in the mode
图神经网络.summary_zh: 实例级解释旨在揭示模型对特定图决策背后的理由。以往方法通过选择重要边来诱导子图解释GNN，其中边重要性通过扰动每条边并观察模型输出变化来评估。本文提出基于粒球的协同边效应方法，通过考虑边之间的协同作用生成更忠实的解释，克服了独立评估边的局限性。

其他.title: From Static Bibliometrics to Dynamic Knowledge Graphs: An LLM-Powered Framework for Modernizing Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) Analytics
其他.title_zh: 从静态文献计量到动态知识图谱：以LLM驱动的框架实现科技与创新分析现代化
其他.summary: Bibliometric indicators - citation counts, h-indexes, co-authorship networks - have long anchored science, technology, and innovation (STI) analytics, yet suffer from temporal lag, semantic shallowness, and an inability to capture the non-linear dynamics of contemporary knowledge ecosystems. 其他.summary_zh: 文献计量指标如引用次数、h指数、合著网络长期支撑科技与创新分析，但存在时间滞后、语义浅薄、无法捕捉当代知识生态非线性动态等缺陷。本文提出一个由LLM驱动的框架，将静态文献计量转化为动态知识图谱，实现实时、语义丰富的STI分析，显著提升知识发现效率。

其他.title: An LLM-Driven Workflow for Automated Process Control Strategy Generation and Tuning from Dynamic Process Models
其他.title_zh: 基于LLM的自动化过程控制策略生成与调优工作流
其他.summary: We present a structured large-language-model-driven workflow for automated multi-variable control design from dynamic process models. The workflow decomposes the design task into constrained code-generation steps: plant-interface construction, normalization, manipulated-variable controlled-variable
其他.summary_zh: 本文提出一种结构化的大语言模型驱动工作流，用于从动态过程模型自动设计多变量控制。该工作流将设计任务分解为受约束的代码生成步骤：工厂接口构建、归一化、操纵变量与受控变量配对、控制器参数整定。实验证明该方法可生成有效控制策略，减少人工干预。

category_summaries.逻辑编程与因果过程: 该方向融合逻辑推理与因果建模，旨在提升AI的符号推理能力。研究重点包括因果结构学习、反事实推理及其在可解释决策中的应用。趋势显示，将因果过程嵌入逻辑编程框架，可增强模型对复杂关系的理解与泛化能力。

category_summaries.机器人学与导航: 关注机器人自主移动与操作，涉及感知-规划-控制闭环。趋势包括基于强化学习的端到端导航、多机器人协作，以及利用视觉语言模型实现自然语言指令跟随。

category_summaries.AI安全与隐私: 研究对抗攻击、模型鲁棒性、数据隐私保护。热点包括后门防御、差分隐私训练、联邦学习安全。趋势向大模型安全对齐与红队测试。

研究亮点2：Agentic Context Management——将智能体上下文管理从内存问题提升为生命周期和架构问题，提出了有效的分层管理策略，对生产级AI智能体有重要实用价值。
研究亮点3：Mean-to-Score Discrete Diffusion——通过后验均值去噪器解决了离散扩散模型中贝叶斯可实现性问题，提升了生成质量，对生成模型领域有理论贡献。
研究亮点1：GRADRAG：跨组件提示自适应框架，首次实现多智能体RAG流水线的协调优化，通过梯度传播联合调整检索器和生成器提示，显著提升整体性能。
研究亮点2：Euclid-MCP：将Prolog确定性推理标准化集成到LLM工作流中，增强多步逻辑推理的可靠性和可解释性，适用于安全关键领域。
研究亮点3：DINOde：连续视觉-文本对齐方法，无需额外标注即可将DINOv3特征与CLIP文本嵌入对齐，在开放词汇语义分割上达到最先进水平。
GraphVid: 提出基于图的可控视频生成框架，通过编辑时空图实现多物体交互的细粒度控制，无需手动轨迹绘制，具有实用价值。
ElasticTTT: 针对测试时调优中先验退化的固有问题，提出弹性约束保留生成先验，显著提升视频编辑保真度，具有理论创新。
Toward cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents: 首次提出密码学可验证授权概念，为自主AI代理提供可审计和不可否认的授权机制，对AI安全具有重要前瞻意义。
研究亮点1：《Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity》提出反事实必要性评分，超越了传统充分性解释，为时间序列分类提供了更忠实的解释方法。
